**What is missing**
The mechanic or capability, and which module it belongs in (`combat`, `spells`, `data`, ...).

**Rule reference**
Table/page reference for the rule, if any. Do not paste rulebook text. Remember the library takes rulebook *values* as registered data, never as code; see `docs/DATA.md`.

**Proposed API**
A sketch of the function signature or type, if you have one.

**Consumer**
Which app would use it and how.
